ProfessionalListView

class ProfessionalListView(parent=None, professional_edit_view_factory=None)[source]

Bases: QDialog, Ui_ProfessionalListView, WindowConfig

Dialog that lists and manages the professionals.

Shows a searchable table (ID and name) and a details panel. The widgets come from Ui_ProfessionalListView; all actions are handled by ProfessionalListController, which calls the methods below to update the window.

Parameters:
parentQDialog | None, optional

Parent widget. Default is None.

professional_edit_view_factoryCallable | None, optional

Creates the edit dialog: factory(parent, professional) returns the edit view. Default is None.

Attributes:
msgMessageService

Service used to show dialogs.

controllerProfessionalListController

Controller of the window.

Methods

populate_table(professionals)

Fill the table.

clear_details()

Clear the details panel.

display_details(professional)

Show the details of a professional.

get_selected_id()

Return the ID of the selected row.

select_row_by_id(professional_id)

Select the row of an ID.

Notes

The window is fixed at 10% narrower and 5% shorter than the parent. Closing it asks for confirmation (translated with self.tr()).

Methods

populate_table(professionals)[source]

Fill the table with ID and name of each professional.

Parameters:
professionalslist[Professional]

The professionals to show.

Notes

Table signals are blocked while filling, so no selection change is reported.

clear_details()[source]

Clear all fields of the details panel.

Show the details of a professional.

Parameters:
professionalProfessional | None

The professional; None clears the panel.

Notes

The type is shown with its translated name.

get_selected_id()[source]

Return the ID of the selected professional.

Returns:
int | None

ID read from the first column, or None when nothing is selected or the text is not a number.

select_row_by_id(professional_id)[source]

Parameters:
professional_idint

ID to select; values of 0 or less are ignored.

Notes

Signals are blocked while selecting, and controller.on_table_selection is called afterwards.
